tasks.label: Fetch and compare remote
args: git fetch origin; git status --short --branch; git log --oneline --decorate -5 --all

tasks.label: Push project to GitHub
args: git add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git commit -m Update-project; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push origin main; exit $LASTEXITCODE
